clips.title: The story
paras: At Booty Bay, the Warsong Axe Shipment waits for its voyage to Ashenvale. The newly forged axes are bound for the Warsong Outriders and the work at their lumber camp.

Axes for the Warsong Lumber Camp wait in Booty Bay. The camp’s woodcutters need a steady supply of durable tools, and not every tool can be forged on the front lines. Orders cross the Great Sea to this neutral goblin port, where the crate is stored near Wharfmaster Lozgil. The sharpened axes are meant for Splintertree Post, where they can be sent onward to the camp. Keeping distant frontier camps supplied takes a long journey across the sea.
